output.headline: Health IT strategics and sponsors form the buyer universe, and the comparable median is a defensible price that the leading buyers can pay.
sentences: Call Evolent Health first, then Blackstone and Epic Systems. All three are high conviction: Evolent and Epic already do deals in the sub-sector, and Blackstone has a platform company there. [E:tier1, E:conviction]

Anchor at the 21.4x median EBITDA multiple from 13 comparable deals. Sponsors earn 25.3% at the ask versus a 20% target, with a $356M ceiling, and Evolent and Epic closed $325M and $767M deals. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed Ciox Health and Cerner (Oracle), now inside Datavant and Oracle, and merged Change Healthcare into UnitedHealth Group; Tier 2 holds sponsors without a distinct angle and thin-record health IT strategics. [E:review, E:tier2]
Diversification and technology capability appear in 100% of 50 Health IT deals, and high growth in 90%, so lead the pitch with the growth story. [E:motives]
